title: Complex work, turned into products people trust
subtitle: Product and UX leadership for B2B workflows, European markets and measurable AI-supported experiences.

bio.short: I lead product and design around complex B2B workflows. At Ninox I ran Product and UX together with nine direct reports. At ChurchDesk I turned a manual coordination process into a reusable platform capability. Today at Bibel TV I combine product management, measurable AI experiences and hands-on agentic delivery.
bio.long:
At Ninox I led Product and Design together for four months: nine direct reports across product design, UX writing, product management and data science. As a Senior Leadership Team member, I owned capacity, allocation, prioritization, team structure and processes for the design function.

At ChurchDesk I led product management for the core vertical-SaaS platform and product design across the company. A request for funeral booking became a reusable capability inside the existing calendar and form builder. Coordination time fell 70% and booking acceptance reached 90% at the launch customer; the capability then shipped to the full customer base.

At Bibel TV I combine product management with direct AI implementation and measurement. A redesign of the live AI Bible-passage entry increased weekly starts 153% on iOS and 85% on Android on four-week before-and-after averages. I also operate an n8n content pipeline and own a conversational product in development. The recurring pattern is turning specialist work into understandable, maintainable product capabilities while keeping human judgment visible.

context.emphasis: Lead with the exact nine-person Product-and-UX scope at Ninox, measured workflow productization at ChurchDesk, and current AI product judgment at Bibel TV.
